Disabling linked icon labels keeps accessible names out of visible link text

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false,\"include_icon_labels\":false},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.markdown()?.content() as Any)
```
